notes: - **Legacy models could never calibrate.** Models seeded before factors carried a `series` ref (the GOOG case) had catalog factors with no way to resolve data — Series showed "—", levels stayed null, every forward projection was flat, and attribution reported +0.00% as if it were a conclusion. `ensure()` now migrates old models by backfilling the catalog FRED ref, so Calibrate from FRED works on them like on new ones. - **The attribution panel now says "nothing to attribute yet"** — with the reason and the remedy (calibrate, or attach series-backed factors) — whenever every factor forecast is
